references.observed: Aerial view shows the two distinct discharge lanes, the long powerhouse at the west toe, an elongated splitter wall and the exposed hillside service structures.
The downstream photo shows the two tall red gantries, the recessed outlet row, glass and white powerhouse facade, crest lift structures and red inscriptions.
The operator lists a 713.2 m main dam, maximum height 106 m and crest elevation 353 m.
The water engineering school distinguishes the main gravity dam, a 144 m earth auxiliary dam, tunnels and the downstream powerhouse.
